data.body: B5 e6c1 RED oracle confirmed before production edits: collected/executed 3 tests under pytest; all 3 failed for the missing git command contract. The visible unit, held-out signed-real-Git unit, and 100-event real-store integration each reject omission of -c log.showSignature=false / --no-renames. Initial oracle run exposed and corrected a test-only shared-subprocess monkeypatch defect under revert-first discipline; the SSH fixture proves log.showSignature=true emits multiple stdout lines, while exact SHA/parity assertions preserve the behavioral contract. Gate: make test/default pytest. Next: physically hold out signed unit + integration, dispatch standard-tier implementer with only happy-path test.
